plugin-info.name: DITA2ePub
plugin-info.description: Modern EPUB 3.3 transformation plugin for DITA-OT 4.4 with accessibility, cover pages, font embedding, and image optimization
plugin-info.author: J. Jeanne

features.feature: EPUB Accessibility 1.1 metadata derived from the content
Themes, platform profiles (Amazon KDP, Apple Books, Kobo) and fixed layout
Cover page generation with multiple styles
Image optimization (JPEG quality, PNG metadata stripping)
10-language internationalization (en, fr, de, es, it, pt, nl, ja, zh)

release.note: Theme system with 5 built-in themes
Platform profiles for Amazon KDP, Apple Books and Kobo
Fixed layout EPUB with viewport, orientation and spread controls
RTL language support with CSS logical properties
Global figure and table numbering across topics
DPUB-ARIA roles, RTL text direction and CSS hyphenation
List of Figures and List of Tables
Locale-aware quotation marks and CJK typography
ISBN/ASIN identifiers, series metadata, contributor roles and BISAC subjects
Auto-generated copyright page and extended landmarks
Custom CSS, footnotes, figure and table numbering
Drop caps, pull quotes and sidebars
Font obfuscation using Adobe/IDPF algorithm per EPUB OCF 3.3
Image optimization with configurable JPEG quality and PNG metadata stripping
Added Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese language support
Dynamic font manifest generation from actual font files
Back-of-book index generation from indexterm elements
Consolidated glossary from glossentry topics
EPUB 3.3 Structural Semantics Vocabulary compliance
Initial release with EPUB3 transformation support
DITA-OT 4.4 compatibility
Accessibility features built-in (WCAG 2.1)
Cover page generation and font embedding
